title: asyncio child watcher functions are deprecated
summary: Python 3.12 deprecates asyncio.set_child_watcher() and asyncio.get_child_watcher(), to be removed in Python 3.14; the event loop now uses the best available child watcher for each platform.

constraints: Keep the behavior of the call unchanged; check the replacement's argument and return-type differences.

steps.title: Remove child watcher setup
steps.instructions: Delete the calls; the event loop picks a child watcher for the platform.

verification.purpose: Run the tests with deprecation warnings as errors when pytest is used.
